title: How we synchronize two lasers with sub-nanosecond jitter on an FPGA
excerpt: Getting excitation and depletion pulses to line up in a STED microscope is a timing problem that pushes FPGAs to their limits. Here's how we solved it.

title: From photon counts to pixels: building a STED image pipeline
excerpt: A walkthrough of the signal processing chain that turns raw detector pulses into a super-resolution image — and why every nanosecond of gating matters.

title: Designing scan patterns that don't melt your sample
excerpt: Raster scanning is simple but brutal on live cells. Spiral and adaptive ROI scans spread the dose better — here's how we generate them on the FPGA.

title: Opto-mechanical design for people who learned CAD the hard way
excerpt: Lessons from designing custom optical mounts when commercial catalog parts almost fit but never quite do. Tolerances, thermal drift, and when to just machine it yourself.

title: Why I moved our microscope control software to Python (and kept the fast parts in C++)
excerpt: Researchers want to tweak acquisition parameters without recompiling firmware. A hybrid architecture gave us the flexibility of Python with the speed we needed for real-time.
